checks.legal: CourtListener and Justia could not be searched directly: the network proxy refuses both hosts and the fetch tool refuses unsearched URLs (Oct. 14, 2026). A site-restricted web search of courtlistener.com/justia.com was run instead, plus news searches. News/site-restricted searches found no criminal or civil case against him. Ethics: House Ethics Committee letter of June 11, 2021 read directly (below).
checks.foreign: Filing-year-2025 annual read directly (scanned form): no foreign assets, income or travel. FARA: exact-name search of the FARA bulk files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), Oct. 13, 2026: no match.
checks.claims: Campaign site refused by the fetch tool; mechanical sample = every checkable claim on his official House biography (7 rated: 2 true, 2 partly, 3 unverifiable). No 2026 ads found in coverage. PolitiFact scorecard: 1 False, 1 Pants on Fire (statements on Katie Hobbs overseeing the 2022 election, Nov. 2022, and a photo of Obama with Rouhani, Jan. 2020); the page did not map ratings to statements, so they are not scored here.
checks.democracy: Clerk roll calls 10 and 11 of 2021 read directly; Wikipedia and KJZZ for statements. Not checked: Jan. 6, 2017 and Jan. 6, 2025 counts, and the Dec. 2020 Texas v. Pennsylvania amicus list.

legal.t: The House adopted H.Res. 789 censuring him (223–207; Democrats 221–0, Republicans 2–207 with Cheney and Kinzinger voting yes and one present) for posting an edited anime video depicting his likeness attacking figures resembling Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and President Biden. The resolution removed him from the Oversight and Natural Resources committees. He called it an attack on his First Amendment rights and re-posted the video; his committee seats were restored after Republicans won the House in 2022.
legal.status: Censure adopted Nov. 17, 2021; committee seats restored after 2022 election

legal.t: The House Ethics Committee received a complaint naming him on Mar. 10, 2021 (Breitbart reported it concerned Jan. 6). A motion to set up an investigative subcommittee failed, and the committee said it would not review the complaint further.

networth.note: Read from the scanned filing-year-2025 annual (OCR plus visual check of the checkboxes): three joint real-estate assets minus one mortgage.

trades.overlap_note: No transactions reported; LegiStorm lists no periodic transaction reports.

note.t: All assets are joint Flagstaff, AZ real estate: Aunt Maude's Store ($250K–$500K), Raine Valley Rd property ($1M–$5M) and 222 E Cedar Ave ($1M–$5M, rental income $15K–$50K). Liability: joint 'new residence' mortgage ($250K–$500K). No outside earned income, positions, agreements or gifts. Sponsored travel: Conservative Partnership Institute, Feb. 7–9, 2025 (DC–Orlando–DC, lodging and food). No foreign assets or income. LegiStorm's index shows extension letters in 2013, 2015, 2019 and 2021; the 2025 annual was filed Apr. 29, 2026, before the May 15 deadline.
